name: hiv_rt_test_docking
description: FRET-restrained two-body docking of HIV-RT (1R0A, body 0: chains A=p66 / B=p51) against its DNA (body 1: chain P), scored with IMP.bff accessible volumes. hiv_rt.fps.json is the converted form of LPs_no_template_old_protein.txt + Distances.txt. Load in the FRET Docking tool or run from the CLI.
